items.title: 7.2 Waves ki superposition ka principle (usool) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.2 with Fig. 7.4 and the noise-cancelling steps (PDF 141-143).

blocks.text: Agar medium ke kisi particle (zarre) par ek hi waqt do waves act karein (asar dalein), to particle ka resultant (kul) displacement un ke alag alag displacements ka algebraic sum (plus/minus ke saath jama) hota hai. Ise principle of superposition (superposition ka usool) kehte hain.
Doosre lafzon mein, alag alag waves ke displacements aapas mein jama ho kar ek naya wave pattern banate hain, jaisa Fig. 7.4 (a aur b) mein hai.
(i) Agar ek doosre par aane wali do waves ka phase ek jaisa ho (same phase), to resultant displacement yeh hoga:
Yahan y₁ = wave 1 ka amplitude, y₂ = wave 2 ka amplitude aur y = resultant amplitude hai.
Khaas taur par agar y₁ = y₂ ho, to resultant displacement yeh hoga:

blocks.alt: Chaar qataren. Wave 1: magenta wave (lehar), crest par chhota displacement y1. Wave 2: us ke sath qadam milati cyan wave, displacement y2. Wave 1 and 2 superposed: dono waves (lehrein) ek axis par, crests ek sath. Resultant wave: kaali wave, usi crest par displacement y, y = y1 + y2.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.4 (a): Ek hi frequency ki do waves ki superposition jo bilkul ek phase mein hain (kitab ki Figure 7.4 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: (ii) Agar ek doosre ko cross karne wali do waves ka phase ulta (opposite phase) ho, to resultant displacement yeh hoga:
Khaas taur par agar y₁ = y₂ ho, to resultant displacement y = 0 hoga.

Isi tarah agar medium ke kisi particle par ek hi waqt n waves act karein aur har wave se us ka displacement y₁, y₂, ……, yₙ ho, to in n waves ke ek saath effect se particle ka resultant displacement y tamam displacements ka algebraic sum hai, yaani:
Isi ko waves ki superposition ka principle kehte hain. Mathematically ise yun bhi likhte hain:
Yahan y(x,t) resultant wave hai, aur y₁(x,t), y₂(x,t), ……, yₙ(x,t) alag alag waves hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar qataren. Wave 1: magenta wave, pehle crest, displacement y1. Wave 2: utni hi cyan wave, pehle trough, displacement y2 neeche. Wave 1 and 2 superposed: ek axis par dono waves ek doosre ka aaina (mirror image). Resultant wave: seedhi lakeer, y = 0.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.4 (b): Ek hi frequency ki do waves ki superposition jo bilkul ulte phase mein hain (kitab ki Figure 7.4 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein crest crest par aata hai, is liye displacements jama hote hain: y = y₁ + y₂ (constructive). (b) mein crest trough par aata hai; jab y₁ aur y₂ barabar hon to y = y₁ − y₂ = 0 (destructive). Noise-cancelling headphones isi (b) wale principle par ‘anti-noise’ bana kar shor khatam karte hain.
Waves ki baat mein y(x,t) wave function hai, yaani kisi point x par aur waqt t par wave ka displacement. Yeh wave ki shakal aur waqt ke saath us ki tabdeeli batata hai.
Superposition ka principle linear waves ya chhote amplitude wali (small amplitude) waves par lagu hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka yeh jumla “linear waves or small” par adhoora (incomplete) chhapa hai. Poora matlab yeh hai: superposition ka principle linear waves, yaani small amplitude (chhote amplitude) wali waves, par lagu hota hai. Bohat bari (non-linear) disturbances mein displacements seedhe jama nahi hote.
Waves ki superposition se kai interesting (dilchasp) phenomena (qudrati waqiaat) paida hote hain:

items: Ek jaisi frequency wali do waves jo ek hi direction (simt) mein chalein (Interference).
Thori si different (alag alag) frequencies wali do waves jo ek hi direction mein chalein (Beats).
Barabar frequency wali do waves jo ulti directions (simt) mein chalein (Stationary waves).

blocks.title: Ponder Upon (ghaur karein)
blocks.text: White light (safed roshni) se bana hua interference pattern: kitab is ki tasveer dikhati hai jis mein rang daar bright (roshan) aur dark (andheri) dhariyan (fringes) hain.
Superposition ke principle ke istemal
Waves ki superposition ka principle istemal kar ke noise-cancelling headphones unwanted noise (bekaar shor) ko khatam kar dete hain, aur sunne ka experience zyada aaram wala (peaceful) ho jata hai.

items: Headphones mein ek ya zyada microphones hote hain jo ird gird ka shor (ambient noise) pakarte hain, jaise peeche logon ki baatein, engine ka shor ya mahaul ka koi bhi shor.
Microphone yeh sound signals headphones ke andar amplifier aur processing unit ko bhejta hai.
Processing unit ek "anti-noise" signal banata hai jo ird gird ke shor ka bilkul ulat hota hai (amplitude barabar, phase ulta).
Phir anti-noise signal headphones mein desired (chaha hua) audio (jaise music ya voice) ke saath chalaya jata hai.
Jab anti-noise signal ird gird ke shor se milta hai to dono waves ek doosre ko cancel (khatam) kar deti hain, aur sunne mein bohat khamoshi ho jati hai.

blocks.text: Yeh misal asal situation ko bohat saada kar ke batati hai, kyunke noise-cancelling headphones achhi cancellation ke liye complex (pecheeda) algorithms aur kai microphones istemal karte hain. Phir bhi un ka kaam samajhne ke liye superposition ka basic (bunyadi) principle hi asal cheez hai.

blocks.prompt: Superposition ka principle bayan kijiye aur us se noise-cancelling headphones ki wazahat kijiye (comprehensive question 7.1; MCQ 7.2). Jab do barabar waves bilkul ulat phase mein milein to result (nateeja) kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Jab do ya zyada waves ek hi waqt kisi particle par act karein to us ka displacement alag displacements ka algebraic sum (jama) hai, y = y1 + y2 + ... + yn. Headphones ird gird ka shor record karte hain, usi amplitude magar ulat phase ka anti-noise signal banate hain aur music ke saath chalate hain; jahan dono milte hain y = y1 - y2 = 0, to shor khatam ho jata hai aur music baqi rehta hai. Bilkul ulat phase mein do barabar waves ka result displacement sifar hai.

blocks.text: Summary (khulasa)

items: Superposition: resultant displacement = alag displacements ka algebraic sum.
Same phase: y = y₁ + y₂ (barabar hon to y = 2y₁); opposite phase: y = y₁ − y₂ (barabar hon to y = 0).
n waves: y = y₁ + y₂ + … + yₙ, ya y(x,t) = y₁(x,t) + … + yₙ(x,t).
Is se interference, beats aur stationary waves bante hain; noise-cancelling headphones anti-noise se shor cancel karte hain.
